cues.text: 今晚八点，老地方。你写好信，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 却发现只能交给一个手脚不干净的信使。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 八点一旦被改成九点，你就得白等一小时。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 今天偏要让他送信，还要让他看不懂，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 动过手脚就被发现。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这场游戏，上网时天天在发生。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 消息经过许多机器，密码学要做的，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就是放心走过一条不放心的路。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 先给信上把锁。朋友没有钥匙，你只好另寄一把。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信使看了直乐：复制一份，再照常送过去，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你们都不会察觉。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 提前见面留把钥匙，当然可以。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 可第一次打开网站，总不能先去它的机房敲门。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 问题还得在这条路上解决。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你和朋友各藏一个秘密，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 把它加工成可以公开的结果。信使只管送结果，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 最里面那一份，始终留在各自手里。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 收到对方的结果，用自己藏的秘密再加工。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 两边竟然得到相同答案。它从来没寄出去，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 却在两端各出现一次。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 拿小数字试试。公开约好五和二十三。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 接下来的计算都只留除以二十三的余数；
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 二十五除以二十三，就留下二。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你藏六，算五的六次方，取余得到八。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 朋友藏十五，同样计算，得到十九。现在，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 把八和十九交给信使交换。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你收到十九，算十九的六次方，再取余，得到二。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 朋友收到八，算八的十五次方，再取余，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 竟然也是二。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 原因藏在指数里：十五乘六，和六乘十五，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 都等于九十。两条计算路线，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 最后落在同一个答案上。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这就是迪菲—赫尔曼密钥交换。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 小数字一试就能猜中；
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 实际要选更大的、经过研究的数学结构，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 让倒着找很困难。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 塞进自己的数；十九送回来时，也被调了包。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 他开始分别跟两边商量秘密。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你手里的钥匙，他有一份；朋友手里的另一把，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 他也有一份。两个人还以为，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 自己一直在跟对方说话。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信从你这里锁好，他打开看，再换一把锁送走。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 朋友照常收到信，他也知道了见面的时间和地点。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这叫中间人攻击。光算出秘密还不够，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 你得认清跟你商量的到底是谁，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 不能让信使换个名字就混进来。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 把朋友换成你访问的网站，网上就用证书认身份。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 浏览器核对网址，再拿到一把公开的身份钥匙，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 用来检查签名。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 证书不能自己随便写。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 直到它原本信任的机构，才能接受这个身份。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 网站还要用自己保管的秘密钥匙，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 给这次商量的记录签名。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 刚才交换的数字也在里面，改过就会影响验证。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信使抄得走证书，拿不到秘密钥匙。他换了数字，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 还借原来的签名蒙混过关，浏览器一核对，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 连接就停了。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 证书核对了名字和身份。至于对方做人靠不靠谱，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它可不替对方担保。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 认准对面，把共同秘密加工成这次连接用的钥匙。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 它保护接下来传的话，跟登录密码分工不同。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信终于可以出发了。字句在你这边变成密文，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 过桥、转弯、经过信使的手，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 到朋友那里才重新拼成能读懂的话。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信使看不懂，索性乱改一处。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 收信人要是照单全收，依然会出事。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 这封信还得加一道检查。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 就拒绝交出里面的内容。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 一个字都没少。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 信被挡在门外。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 收信人不会把一段遭到改动的数据，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 当成你的原话。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 路上的机器照样忙碌，
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.text: 秘密留在真正说话的人手里。
cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained

cues.timingMethod: Whisper word anchors + measured speech energy; standard source text retained
